headline: Flood and building permit appeals continued to December 10

meeting.summary: The board continued two permit violation appeals to December 10th, 2026, while the appellants arrange an archaeological survey.
meeting.recap: The Board of Variance and Appeals meeting began at 1:33.[[0:00:30]] There was no public testimony.[[0:00:39]] The board had quorum, meaning enough members were present to do business.[[0:02:08]] One appeal challenges a notice of violation for building in a special flood hazard area without a flood development permit.[[0:02:52]] The other appeal challenges a notice of violation for building or renovating without a building permit.[[0:03:34]] The board received a stipulation, an agreement between both sides, to continue the case for four to six months.[[0:04:28]] The chair said the case has been on the calendar for six years.[[0:04:44]] The appellants' attorney said the planning department asked for an archaeological survey.[[0:04:58]] The attorney said they are hiring an archaeologist and the permit can move forward after that work is done.[[0:05:07]] The attorney said he hopes the survey will be done in the next few months.[[0:05:21]] The attorney said December 10th would work because he has a trial on Kauaʻi in late November.[[0:06:53]] The board voted to continue the case to December 10th, 2026.[[0:07:23]] The meeting ended at 1:40 p.m.[[0:08:28]]
decided: The board approved continuing the combined appeals to December 10th, 2026.
meeting.next: The appellants plan to have an archaeologist complete the survey the planning department requested.
